version: Pajek 6.02 (64-bit, Pajek64.zip of 2025-12-31) under Wine 9.0 on Xvfb
command: Pajek.exe running the startup log Pajek.log: LOADINI oracle.ini (Pajek's SAVEINI defaults, Draw window 500 x 500); N 1 RDN "<file>" (127); E 1 DRAW 0 0 0 0 0 (Draw > Network); E 1 SVG 0 0 0 0 0 "<out>.svg" 1 0 (Draw > Export > 2D > SVG > General, SVG with Controls); EXIT

canvas.requested: 500 x 500 px (the Draw window's size: the 0..1 square of the file's coordinates at 500 per unit, as Pajek's EPS export maps it; vertex sizes, line widths and fonts are fixed pixels whatever the window)

fonts: as Pajek writes them (its default label font, Arial); the PNG maps them to the pinned fonts
svgPostprocessing: the CreationDate comment (the run's clock time) is replaced with a fixed text and Windows line ends become Unix ones; nothing else changes. Pajek always adds its signature layer (id PajekSig: the spider logo and the word Pajek, bottom left), which is not part of the network.
